newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Crude oil slide slugs Woodside shares.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Crude oil slide slugs Woodside shares.

text.p: A dip in the crude oil price drove shares in major oil and gas producer Woodside Petroleum Ltd to a nine-week low of A$8.76 on Tuesday, brokers said.
In New York, crude oil futures slid to their lowest level since August, led down by forecasts that the tail end of the North American winter would look more like an early spring.
"It is purely on the back of the fall in the oil price," said a Melbourne dealer, adding that the retreat in Woodside's price was bringing it back to fair value based on fundamentals.
"The premium is coming out of that share price and it is starting to look fundamentally better-priced," the dealer said.
By 1.15 p.m. (0215 GMT), Woodside shares were 26 cents lower at A$8.77 on turnover of 1.2 million shares.
